integrity: Derived by exact positive principal-minor summation and a finite-difference simplicity proof. Standalone finite tests use rational arithmetic and are not a substitute for the proof. No claim of independent verification or external certification.
limitations: Exact but implicit singular-value list; only geometric point-mass weights on coefficient-normalized Hardy space for \(0<t<1\). No uniform root-isolation bounds or general-weight extension. Full-text comparison to arXiv:2606.15875 was incomplete, and an unindexed equivalent q-Bessel operator reduction remains a possible originality risk.
title: Hahn–Exton zeros determine every singular value of a geometric Rhaly operator
